articleTitle: Investigation of solution of the nonlinear synthesis problem for the waveguide array
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The synthesis problem of the waveguide array according to the prescribed amplitude radiation pattern is considered. The analysis problem is solved with due regard for the mutual coupling of the array radiators. The variational approach for the statement and solution of the synthesis problem is used. The functional representing the mean-square deviation of the prescribed and synthesized radiation patterns is used as a criterion of optimization. The appropriate nonlinear equation is obtained. The investigation of solutions of this equation is carried out for the various prescribed radiation patterns in a wide range of modification of the array electrophysical parameters.

articleTitle: Inverse scattering of a buried imperfect conductor
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The problem of determining the shape of an imperfectly conducting cylinder buried in a half-space by a genetic algorithm is investigated. Assume that a conducting cylinder of unknown shape and conductivity is buried in one half-space and scatters the field incident from another half-space where the scattered field is measured. Based on the boundary condition and the measured scattered field, a set of nonlinear integral equations is derived and the imaging problem is reformulated into an optimization problem.

articleTitle: Non-uniform conforming mesh generator for FDTD scheme in 3D cylindrical coordinate system
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: In this paper a non-uniform conforming mesh generator, developed using a combination of Matlab visual capabilities and the computational power of Fortran code, is described. The developed mesh-generating package can produce all the necessary input data for finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) Maxwell's equations solver, operating for the fields and geometry in a 3D cylindrical coordinate system. The FDTD solver is specially modified to handle conforming cells close to the surfaces of metallic objects. Such an approach, known in the literature as the contour path method makes it possible to accurately model smooth curved surfaces.

articleTitle: Convergence of iterative method for problem with free phase in case of isometric operator
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The problem with free phase is the problem in which only the modulus of the right hand side is given. The case is considered when a linear operator of the problem is acting in complex Hilbertian spaces. The pseudo-solutions of the problem is found from a nonlinear functional equation. The convergence of an iterative method for this equation is proved for the case, when the operator of the problem is isometric.

articleTitle: The antenna shape in the line for microwave power transmission by a long beam
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The energy transmission coefficient from the radiating antenna to the receiving antenna depends in particular on the antenna shapes. Two lines are compared in the paper. The antennas in these lines are connected by affinor transformations. It is shown that the transmission coefficient in such lines are equal one to other. The conditions for the antennas shapes which should be fulfilled to make this coefficient maximal are found in the second part-in the assumption that antennas consisting of many separate "islands" are not considered, although such antennas give probably the best solution. The method of finding the optimal shape of the radiating antenna, if the shape of the receiving antenna is given, is also considered.

articleTitle: Calculation of pulse propagation in coaxial cables with multi-layered insulation system
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: In this paper a simple and efficient method for the calculation of multi-layered coaxial cables is proposed. The parameters of an equivalent transmission line are calculated. These calculations are compared with FDTD results and measurements, and show a good agreement. The developed approach is especially suitable for fast and easy calculation of the propagation characteristics of multi-layered coaxial cables with high permittivity and conductivity, where other methods are less efficient.

articleTitle: Absorption properties of microstrip array C-shaped elements
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The absorption electromagnetic properties of a double periodic microstrip structure consisting of complex strip elements, particularly C-shaped elements is studied.

articleTitle: Numerical solution of synthesis problem of flat microstrip antenna array according to the prescribed power directivity pattern
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The variational synthesis problem of a flat microstrip antenna array according to the prescribed directivity pattern by power is considered. The mutual influence of their elements is taken into account in an approximation of the given surface currents distribution on the radiators. The effective computing algorithm of finding the nonlinear synthesis equations solutions of various types is proposed. These equations are Euler ones of the researched functional. The synthesis numerical examples of the space directivity pattern are presented.

articleTitle: Calculation of singular and hypersingular integrals in scalar diffraction problem
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The axisymmetric scalar diffraction problem is presented. The singular and hypersingular integrals with normal derivative of double layer potential are considered. The methods of singular and hypersingular integrals calculation are proposed.

articleTitle: About relativistic limitation of frequency dependence of propagation constant for transmission line
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: Each transmission line can be characterized by some function h(/spl omega/) in such a way that: function exp(i/spl omega/t) given at z=0, generates function exp(i/spl omega/t-ih(/spl omega/)z) that arises at z/spl ges/0. Assume that at /spl omega//spl rarr//spl infin/ function h(/spl omega/)/spl rarr//spl omega//c; more exactly: the limit of the phase velocity /spl omega//h(/spl omega/) at infinite large frequency is c. The velocity c is introduced in the theory in this way. This assumption is not connected with the relativistic limitation. It is known that there are no relativistic limitation on the value of the group velocity (dh/d/spl omega/)/sup -/1.

articleTitle: About design of the adaptive antenna with chiral coating for portable cellular phones
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: An adaptive portable antenna with extended possibilities to control radiating, directional, polarisation and compatibility properties is proposed. A physical model of the antenna including the absorbing human head is analysed, and the program complex for calculating the antenna characteristics is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Calculation of multiple characteristic numbers of a completely continuous operator using the modified method of successive approximations
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: It is proved that one can calculate multiple characteristic numbers of a given completely continuous operator using the modified method of successive approximations. A way to calculate the eigenfunctions of this operator is indicated.

articleTitle: On the theory of Hallen integral equation
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: A strict approach to solution of the Hallen integral equation for the current density of a symmetric active dipole is proposed. It is shown that the nucleus of the equation has a logarithmic characteristic. The solution, which at the dipole edges, satisfies the Meiksner's condition of the /spl rho/1/2/spl rarr/0 type (at /spl rho//spl rarr/0) was found, that assures uniqueness of the desired solution.

articleTitle: General formulation and MAS solution of the scattering problem upon the arbitrary 3D structure of complex materials
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: An efficient solution to the 3-D scattering problem for the complex material structure is presented. The computer code to calculate and visualize radiation, propagation, scattering and polarization properties of complicated structures is described. The numerical results, illustrating the electromagnetic properties of lossy dielectric, chiral, Tellegen and fully biisotropic structures are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The research of the dynamic characteristics of the ultrawide-band radiators
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: Algorithms for the calculation of the spatial-temporary and spatial-frequency responses of ultrawide-band radiating structures of surface type for the example of a TEM-horn with large electrical size are offered. The results of the calculations of the amplitude-frequency and pulse characteristics for different angles of observation are determined.

articleTitle: The method for acoustic and EM waves field visualization and based on it experimental setup for ultrasonic tomography
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: In the Laboratory of Applied Electrodynamics a holographic technique for the visualization of wave fields has previously been developed. This method is based on the method of auxiliary sources (MAS) and allows to reconstruct an image of the object(s) illuminated by an ultrasonic or EM field source by processing the data of the scattered field, the amplitudes and phases measured in the nearby zone. The numerical experiments were done to verify this method and prove the proposed approach. Together with this, an experimental setup was constructed to measure the complex values of the ultrasonic field's scattered from the illuminated object(s). This data was used for the further numerical processing and the reconstruction of the wave field and object image.

articleTitle: Diffraction of a plane electromagnetic wave at the systems consisting of cylinders with periodic discontinuity in the axial direction
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The problem of diffraction of a plane E-polarized electromagnetic wave at an infinitely long circular cylinder with periodic discontinuity in the axial direction is considered. An example of application of the obtained results in practice is given.

articleTitle: Diffraction phenomena at the transversal edges of corner reflector antenna of arbitrary apex angle
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: On the basis of the uniform geometrical diffraction theory (UGTD) method the author analyzes the influence of diffraction effects at the transversal edges of a corner reflector on the main polarization field amplitudes in the broadside direction of the antenna. It is calculated as a function of the dipole-to-corner spacing and reflecting surfaces sizes of the corner with different apex angles.

articleTitle: Two approaches to analysis of irregular dispersion of electrodynamic structures
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The dispersion laws (spectral characteristics) considering Morse critical points (MCP) are developed from a rigorous solution of the homogeneous boundary value problem of a laterally inhomogeneous dielectric layer. Knowledge of the anomalies of the spectra near the MCP, feasibility of their analytical treatment by the both direct numerical analytical method and an alternative approach based on experimental results, and dispersion equations of the free oscillations provide the basis on which the local equations of the space-time evolution of the layer field are furnished near the MCP of irregular dispersion.

articleTitle: Back reflection of sound beam from an elastic cylinder at oblique incidence
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The scattering of a bounded beam of ultrasound obliquely incident upon an elastic circular cylinder of infinite length is investigated. A cross-section of the wave beam is narrow in the axial direction of the cylinder and unbounded in the perpendicular direction, i.e. the sound beam is considered as an "acoustical knife". This problem is solved by means of the exponential Fourier transform for the axial variable and the modal series for the polar variables. On basis of the high-frequency expansions and the steepest descent method (when the saddle point is located near the pole) the conditions of Rayleigh surface wave back reradiation are obtained.

articleTitle: About structure of solutions of nonlinear synthesis problem of linear antenna according to the prescribed power directivity pattern
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: As an example of the synthesis problem of a linear antenna according to the prescribed power directivity pattern (DP), the results of research of the structure and properties of nonlinear integrated equation solutions, which is the Euler one of the goal functional, are presented. This functional includes both the requirement on the mean-square deviation, the given and synthesized DP by power, and the weighed restriction on the norm of the excitation sources in the form of the stabilizing functional. On the basis of the methods of branching theory of the nonlinear equations solutions it is shown that for the nonlinear synthesis problem the bifurcation of the solutions is characteristic. The equations for finding the bifurcation points are obtained. The quantity and characteristic properties difference from trivial solutions in the space of real continuous functions are determined.

articleTitle: Surface wave diffraction by a phased array of rectangular waveguides
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The surface wave to waveguide mode conversion at a phased array is studied. The excitation efficiency of the fundamental waveguide mode is analyzed.

articleTitle: A microstrip radiator for reflector antennas
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: The use of an antenna array as a patch in a reflector antenna to obtain the circular polarization of the radiating electromagnetic wave is investigated. Used in the calculation for this type of antenna for the first time, the suggested method takes into consideration the mutual coupling between separate patches of the mentioned array and antenna patch matching with its feed lines.

articleTitle: Finite signal reconstruction from its Fourier's spectrum
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: Regularization theory for the calculation of the Fourier transformations of continuous functions that vanish at infinity is considered. The procedure is based on use of the Gaussian means. It is shown that the Tikhonov regularization method of the first order gives a stabilizing multiplier in the form of rational functions. Regularization of the continuous and discrete and fast multidimensional Fourier transformations are considered as well. The analytical study and computational treatment of the problem are presented.

articleTitle: On differentiability of a functional arisen in antenna synthesis theory
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: A nonlinear functional which has arisen in antenna synthesis theory according to the amplitude radiation pattern, is considered. The functional contains the modulus of a complex function; it is not Gateaux differentiable in complex Hilbertian spaces. The problem is reformulated for appropriate real spaces in which the functional is Gateaux differentiable.

articleTitle: One numerical method for solution of the nonlinear spectral problems
publicationTitle: DIPED - 2000. Proceedings of 5th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (IEEE Cat. No.00TH8508)
abstract: One iterative method for the solution of the generalized spectral problem for a matrix with elements analytically depending on the spectral parameter is developed and justified.
